reason: Mum is at an early stage and still gets around her own neighbourhood, so an AirTag or a kids' watch covers the wandering worry for a fraction of the cost. A camera on her body, even one that stays off until an SOS, feels like watching her, and I would be asking her to agree to something she may not fully understand.
objection: She would take it off or forget to charge it, and then I am paying for a device that does nothing. Worse, a camera on her is a dignity problem I would have to live with every time she caught me looking at the log.
would_change_my_mind: If she starts wandering or getting lost on her own, and the 30-day trial shows she will actually wear it without a fight, I would switch from the AirTag to this.
